summary: TypeScript scripts are well-structured with proper type safety and error handling, but workflow is incomplete and unmaintainable. Critical issues: (1) Missing fixtures/license-config.json and fixtures/sample-package.json referenced in workflow env vars — workflow will fail immediately at the generate-report step; (2) Missing package.json — `bun install` will fail; (3) Bun version unpinned (`bun-version: latest`) breaks reproducibility; (4) Duplicate steps across jobs (checkout@v4, setup-bun, install at lines 15-21 and 29-35) should be factored into composite action or matrix strategy; (5) No tsconfig.json provided for TypeScript strict mode enforcement. Scripts themselves show good practice (explicit types, proper async/await, defensive file checks), but workflow is non-functional as delivered.
